gloss.instrument: The instrument a species sings with. Picked by how its family lives (hunter, grazer, producer scavenger). Its exact voice and timbre is determined by its color.
guide.overview.p2: Energy is the only thing that enters and leaves. The first kind of energy is the <light>light</light>: the pool of water receives a different amount of background light every era, and is brightest in the bands of the <tide>Tide</tide>. The second kind of energy is heat: emitted by oxidizing <framboid>framboids</framboid>, rotting husks, and by the energy cells spend on <upkeep>upkeep</upkeep> which warms the <water>water</water>, spreads, drifts on the currents and is lost to the deep. Everything you see grows out of a handful of local rules applied to every particle many times a second.
